title: Microsoft Surface Pro 12" Snapdragon X Plus (8 Core), Wi-Fi, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD [2025] $1699.15 Shipped @ Microsoft
body:
Deal: Microsoft Surface Pro 12" Snapdragon X Plus (8 Core), Wi-Fi, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD [2025] $1699.15 Shipped @ Microsoft

[kulakula] Disclaimer I wouldn't touch this thing with a 10ft. pole for the price of $1699. I wasn't sure how to get the stacking idea out to folks. I can leverage TRS to further bring down the price which makes it an insanely lucrative deal.
[mickeyjuiceman] This is either a deliberate lie or complete ignorance.
[boozed] https://www.cpubenchmark.net/compare/6732vs4804/Snapdragon-X-Plus-(8-core)-vs-Intel-i5-12500T
[puffinfresh] I initially paid this much, then it went on sale and the code still worked, so they refunded the difference and I got it for about $1445. The next day they changed the sale and dropped the price further, but you could no longer stack the 15% off code. That only ended yesterday I think.
All up I paid about $2105 for this and an Xbox Series S, minus $839 trade in for my Surface Go 3, and 2*$400 back from the NAB credit card deal (bought $1k gift cards on one card and paid the balance on another card). So $466 out of pocket for a massive Surface upgrade (excluding the keyboard) and an Xbox. That's before I claim them on tax too, so I will actually end up profiting.
However, the pain of dealing with Microsoft wasn't worth it. Every single step of the purchase process had unnecessary friction and required me to contact support. They are incompetent and unable to solve the simplest of issues, such as issuing an accurate tax invoice.
[Merlict] How was the trade in part? Heard complaints about their trade-in partner.
[puffinfresh] They were good. I'm waiting for payment to come through, but they have confirmed I'll get the full amount. The hickup for me was again with Microsoft; the trade in company requires you to print your order page to PDF, but it didn't display correctly. I had to use developer settings and mess with the code to get it to work. It wasn't accepted by their automated system, but they manually processed it quickly. The option to have it manually checked wasn't obvious.
[enigma48] Decent experience here too.
I had the same issue about getting the sales order number recognised, but converted a screenshot to a pdf and that worked for the automated system. Money was in my account without issue a couple weeks later - they didn’t even try to haggle over “like new” condition.
[Jay-rad] "That's before I claim them on tax too, so I will actually end up profiting."
For work a 50% work related write-off as a depreciating asset or whats the magic here?
[puffinfresh] The initial plan was to salary sacrifice, but I suspect the provider my employer uses won't be too happy with the tax receipt that Microsoft has provided. For the laptop, I have two invoices that each only show the portion paid with either credit card or gift cards; it looks like I bought two seperate devices. For the Xbox, the tax receipt only shows the amount paid with gift cards, which was $30; the rest isn't shown anywhere and Microsoft are unwilling to escalate despite me informing them of their legal obligation to provide an accurate tax invoice. That was after they played transfer tennis with me through every department they have.
So I'll just claim at tax time. The Surface is 100% for work, and will need to be depreciated over multiple years. The Xbox is partially for work; I teach game development.
[Wonderstache] This exact model was $1499 on their site less than a week ago. All stores jacked up their prices a few days ago to $1999 after MS changed their prices.
[jackary] Thank you for confirming this was the case. Was looking last week, then saw this deal today… thought I was going mad.
[tobinm] And be careful watching the base model now as that only has 8GB. It is the same price point the 16GB used to occupy (which also used to be the base model before they introduced the 8GB).
[mickeyjuiceman] @jackary: Subject to even worse RAM/memory availability, though
[jackary] @mickeyjuiceman: Oh, my little jab was more related to how bloated ass Windows 11 is.
On a Mac you can just get away with it, on my work-issued SQ3 Surface Pro 9… it was truly almost unusable. Opening MS Outlook for instance was a 69.420 second task, and I work for a small NFP so it was hardly taxing stuff.
[frankfu1122] How do you get the Amex offer if you've done the trade in for $848?
[puffinfresh] The trade in is paid as a cash transfer to your Paypal account, not as a refund to your credit card.
[yyebo] unfortunately it only accept 256gb and 512gb for ipad pro 10.5
[puffinfresh] It's an insane price. You'd at least hope it had a battery and could be used wirelessly like one of their other Surface keyboards. It can be had for $200 on Ebay. I got an open box one for $160.
